evidence.note: Sends Authorization = "Bearer " & Extension.CurrentCredential()[Key] on every data request.
Authentication record declares a Key (bearer token) credential type.
The key is sent in the Authorization request header.
Data is fetched with Web.Contents(url, requestOptions).
Takes a url parameter (API base URL, sample https://api.attio.com at line 655) and an optional options record.
Declares url as text and options as record for the user.

options-fields.text: The options record accepts only TestConnection (logical, default false), read with Record.FieldOrDefault. When true, ContentsImpl runs the connection probe instead of building the navigator.

evidence.note: Reads TestConnection and branches to Attio.TestConnectionProbe when it is true.
offsetLimit style pages by offset, using NextOffset metadata.
cursor style pages by cursor token, using NextCursor metadata.
getNotes uses Style = "offsetLimit"; similar offset use at lines 396, 413, 447.
getMeetings uses Style = "cursor" with CursorParam and CursorField nextCursor.
Both offset and cursor pages are produced by Table.GenerateByPage.
The helper is built on List.Generate. Only the outer construct is named here.

paging-stop.text: Offset style stops when a page has fewer rows than PageSize (default 50) or zero rows (lines 571-573). Cursor style stops when the response has hasMore = false, or the cursor is null or blank (lines 594-596). Table.GenerateByPage stops when the next-page function returns null (lines 603-604 and 610-613, via the List.Generate condition at line 729).

evidence.note: nextOffset is null when itemCount < __pageSize, and the page is null when itemCount = 0.
nextCursor is null when hasMore = false or the cursor is null or blank.
Parses the response with Json.Document.
Hardcoded table of column names with M types (Text.Type, Logical.Type, type any, type nullable record) for each collection.
Assigns the declared types to returned data columns with Table.TransformColumnTypes (line 768) and Table.TransformColumns (line 772).
An empty result builds #table with the declared column names, and ApplySchema still applies the declared types.
The empty first page falls back to toTable({}), which keeps the declared columns.
Every data request sets ManualStatusHandling = {500, 502} and inspects the status code (lines 480, 487, 489).
Raises error Error.Record("HttpRequestFailed", ...) with the status when retries are exhausted.
Retries with Function.InvokeAfter and a delay that grows with each attempt.

retry-rule.text: Only HTTP 500 and 502 are retried (line 476). There are at most 2 retries after the first send, so 3 sends in total (attempt < 2, line 490). The delay before retry n is n seconds, from (attempt + 1) * 1 (line 491), so 1 s then 2 s. Other statuses, including 429, are not retried.

evidence.note: manualRetryStatusCodes = {500, 502}.
Retry condition, attempt limit, and the error raised after retries.
Function-level Documentation.Name, Caption, and Description on the function type.
Parameter Documentation.FieldCaption and Documentation.FieldDescription for url and options.
Documentation.SampleValues for url.
Hardcoded list of eight collections (Objects, Lists, WorkspaceMembers, Notes, Tasks, Threads, Meetings, Webhooks), plus Self at 451-467.
Builds the navigation table from that fixed list, with every row a leaf (IsLeaf true, line 641).
Dedicated probe that requests /v2/objects and returns a Connected table.
TestConnection = (resource) => {"Attio.Contents", resource, [TestConnection = true]} routes to the probe.
Branches to Attio.TestConnectionProbe when TestConnection is true.
No Table.View, Value.NativeQuery, Odbc, or SQL generator code exists. Table operations run locally.
All code is in one Attio.pq file with no .pqm modules.
Uses Extension.LoadString for captions, descriptions, labels, and button text.
Icons loaded with Extension.Contents("Attio16.png") and similar files.
Publish record sets Beta = true.
No Diagnostics.Trace calls in the connector.
No export job or status polling. Retries are the only delayed re-sends (line 491).
Only GET requests through Web.Contents. No Action functions or table mutations.
